question: Avadhesh starts from Point A and drives 10 km towards the east. He then takes a left turn, drives 10 km, turns left and drives 10 km. Then he takes a final left turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point M. How far and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A from Point M? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
Given: 

Avadhesh starts from Point A and drives 10 km towards the east. 

Takes a left turn, drives 10 km, 

Turns left and drives 10 km. 

Takes a final left turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point M. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4fa6795ab1311431d24587208729184a1599493118d2b1639d409753ddae3dcd.png] 

Here, he should be drive **'7 km towards the South'** direction to reach Point A from Point M.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
